parts.label: (b)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Identify $x=-4$ as the $x$-value of the maximum point. B1FT SOI; FT their lower critical value from (a). Integrate correctly: $y=x^3+5x^2-8x+c$. B1; condone $f(x)=$. Use $y=27$ and $x=\text{their }-4$ (or $x=\text{their }\frac23$) in their cubic integral; their value must come from (a) or a restart. M1. $c=-21$, hence $y=x^3+5x^2-8x-21$. A1; do not ISW if they continue to find a straight line; condone omission of final statement if the general equation was seen. Total: 4.
